title: Fill the GAP: A Granular Alignment Paradigm for Visual Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.12374v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Visual latent reasoning lets a multimodal large language model (MLLM) create intermediate visual evidence as continuous tokens, avoiding external tools or image generators. However, existing methods usually follow an output-as-input latent paradigm and yield unstable gains. We identify a feature-space mismatch behind this instability: dominant visual-latent models build on pre-norm MLLMs and reuse decoder hidden states as predicted latent inputs, even though these states occupy a substantially different norm regime from the input embeddings the model was trained to consume. This mismatch makes direct latent feedback unreliable. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose GAP, a Granular Alignment Paradigm for visual latent modeling. GAP aligns visual latent reasoning at three levels: data-level alignment grounds latent targets with inspectable auxiliary visual supervision; feature-level alignment maps decoder outputs into input-com

translated_title: 弥合GAP：面向多模态大语言模型视觉推理的细粒度对齐范式
translated_abstract: 视觉潜在推理使多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能够将中间视觉证据生成为连续的token，从而避免依赖外部工具或图像生成器。然而，现有方法通常遵循“输出即输入”的潜在范式，带来的性能增益并不稳定。我们识别出这种不稳定性背后的特征空间失配问题：主流的视觉潜在模型构建于pre-norm架构的MLLM之上，并将解码器隐藏状态直接复用为预测的潜在输入，尽管这些隐藏状态所处的范数区间与模型训练时实际消费的输入嵌入存在显著差异。这种失配使得直接的潜在反馈并不可靠。基于这一诊断，我们提出了GAP——一种面向视觉潜在建模的细粒度对齐范式。GAP在三个层级上对齐视觉潜在推理：数据级对齐通过可检验的辅助视觉监督来锚定潜在目标；特征级对齐将解码器输出映射到与输入兼容的空间……
tldr: 该论文诊断出视觉潜在推理增益不稳定的根源在于解码器隐藏状态与输入嵌入之间的特征空间失配，并提出GAP细粒度对齐范式，通过数据级、特征级等三个层级的对齐实现稳定可靠的潜在视觉推理。
en_tdlr: GAP resolves the feature-space mismatch between decoder hidden states and input embeddings that makes latent feedback unreliable, by aligning visual latent reasoning at three granular levels, thereby achieving stable and reliable gains in multimodal large language models.
